capabilities: Publish selected Markdown files to Feishu/Lark, Notion, or ima
Replace remote editable bodies on later publishes while preserving Notion child pages
Batch publish multiple files and providers with progress, cancel, and retry
Store provider credentials in Obsidian SecretStorage
Write provider binding fields into note frontmatter
disambiguation: Not a two-way sync tool; remote edits are never merged back and there is no directory mirroring or remote folder creation.
extras: Community Plugins approval is still pending; the README documents BRAT and manual release installation in the meantime. Detailed setup guides, capability matrix, and troubleshooting are hosted in external documentation. A Bilibili video tutorial is linked. Interface supports Simplified Chinese and English; auto-open applies only to single-note, single-provider Feishu/Lark or Notion successes. No telemetry; logs are error-only and redacted. License MIT.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to publish local Markdown notes to external platforms such as Feishu/Lark, Notion, or ima.

requires.name: Feishu/Lark, Notion, or ima account for each enabled provider
Provider API credentials stored in Obsidian SecretStorage

summary: One-way publisher that sends Obsidian Markdown notes to Feishu/Lark, Notion, and ima without merging remote edits back.
